description: Create complete AWS infrastructure-as-code in infra/ directory: CloudFormation template, Dockerfiles, Docker Compose, Nginx config, deploy scripts, and Portuguese README
steps: Create infra/ directory at the root of the repository

Create infra/cloudformation.yaml - CloudFormation template that provisions: VPC with public/private subnets, EC2 instance (t3.medium) with Docker in user-data, RDS PostgreSQL (db.t3.micro) in private subnet, ALB with HTTPS listeners using ACM certificates, ACM certificate for creatools.co + *.creatools.co + creatools.stream + *.creatools.stream + creatools.live + *.creatools.live, Route 53 hosted zone records (A/AAAA alias to ALB) for all 3 domains, Security Groups: ALB allows 80/443 inbound, EC2 allows traffic from ALB + SSH, RDS allows 5432 from EC2 only

Create infra/Dockerfile - Multi-stage build: stage 1 installs pnpm and builds the monorepo (pnpm install + pnpm run build), stage 2 copies built artifacts (api-server dist/ + frontend dist/public/) into a minimal node:22-slim image. API server runs on port 3000 inside container. Frontend static files served by nginx.

Create infra/docker-compose.yml - Services: api (build from Dockerfile, port 3000, env vars DATABASE_URL/JWT_SECRET/PORT/NODE_ENV), nginx (nginx:alpine image, volumes for nginx config and frontend static files, ports 80/443 exposed). Depends on RDS being available (external). Environment variables referenced from .env file.

Create infra/nginx/nginx.conf - Main nginx config with 3 server blocks: (1) creatools.co - serves frontend static files from /usr/share/nginx/html/ and proxies /api/* to http://api:3000, (2) creatools.stream - proxies all requests to http://api:3000 for overlay links, (3) creatools.live - proxies all requests to http://api:3000 for profile links. All with SSL termination handled by ALB (nginx listens on 80 internally). Include proper proxy headers (X-Forwarded-For, X-Real-IP, Host).

Create infra/deploy.sh - User-data bootstrap script for EC2: installs Docker and Docker Compose, clones the repo (or pulls updates), creates .env file from CloudFormation parameters (DATABASE_URL constructed from RDS endpoint, JWT_SECRET, STRIPE keys etc.), runs docker compose up -d. Includes health check loop.
Create infra/.env.example - Template showing all required environment variables with descriptions

Create infra/README.md - Complete deployment guide in Portuguese (pt-BR) covering: pre-requisitos (AWS CLI, dominio configurado, certificado ACM), passo-a-passo do deploy via CloudFormation (aws cloudformation create-stack command), parametros do template, configuracao pos-deploy (DNS, SSL validation, environment variables), troubleshooting, como atualizar o app, custos estimados
acceptance_criteria: infra/ directory exists at repository root with all files
CloudFormation template is valid YAML with all required resources (VPC, Subnets, EC2, RDS, ALB, ACM, Route53, SecurityGroups)
Dockerfile builds successfully with docker build
docker-compose.yml is valid and references correct services/ports
nginx.conf handles all 3 domains with correct routing (frontend static, API proxy, overlay proxy, profile proxy)
deploy.sh is executable and contains complete bootstrap logic
README.md is in Portuguese and provides complete step-by-step instructions
verification: Run: docker build -f infra/Dockerfile -t creatools-app . (from repo root) to verify the Dockerfile builds
Run: python3 -c "import yaml; yaml.safe_load(open('infra/cloudformation.yaml'))" to validate YAML syntax
Run: docker run --rm -v $(pwd)/infra/nginx:/etc/nginx/conf.d nginx:alpine nginx -t to validate nginx config syntax
